name: Upgrade: Elemental Affinity
comment: From the server Lua shipped with the client (research/lmoxide-notes/client-survey/stats-and-minigames.md, stats_upgrade_lua.json): spell line 5008: DoElementalAffinity (script 1793) casts the role's affinity buff (tunables elements.affinity) in a zone of the minifigure's element.
